name: time-estimate-field
title: Time estimate field
description: Type 1h 30m, 90m or 1.5h and it understands: a text field that parses durations the way task trackers do and shows what it read.
docs: value and onValueChange speak minutes, or null when the field was emptied or could not be read; the second argument says whether it is inside max, and a longer estimate is still reported. It commits on Enter or when the field is left and rewrites the text as 1h 30m. A day is hoursPerDay hours (8) and a week daysPerWeek days (5).
